name: The Friday Night Dump, Autopsied
note: This lexicon is written BEFORE any measurement in this session. The recon's 12-form probe is NOT this pre-registration and is not silently promoted; it is reported separately as `recon_probe` for comparison. Forms are chosen by SPEECH-ACT category and face validity, never by outcome.

span.why_restated: Press lane 2001-2012 = 2,321 statements across 12 distinct offices; 69% are one member (L000551). Cannot carry a weekday analysis. Pre-2013 = UNDERPOWERED, reported not computed.

halves.note: Split at the 2021 coverage cliff deliberately: the cliff is a real regime boundary of the instrument. Reported as coverage-confounded; the B-decay sub-finding is therefore reported per-office-per-day, never as a raw level.

gate.primary: CONFIRM iff Friday walk-back rate >= 1.5x the Mon-Thu mean rate in BOTH halves (spec verbatim).
gate.sub_finding: Did the Dump die? B-half Friday ratio < A-half Friday ratio, per-office-per-day normalized.
gate.holiday_eve: CONFIRM iff holiday-eve rate >= 1.5x matched same-weekday non-holiday-eve rate.

power_floor_stated_before_looking.rule: >= 200 Friday lexicon hits per half AND >= 20,000 Friday statements per half, else UNDERPOWERED.
power_floor_stated_before_looking.why: Below this a 1.5x ratio is not separable from Poisson noise at these base rates.

core.rationale: High-precision speech acts of CORRECTION / RETRACTION / APOLOGY. If the Friday Night Dump exists as folk theory describes, it lives here.

broad.rationale: core + softer CLARIFICATION forms. Reported alongside core regardless of outcome; declared now so neither can be chosen after the fact.

a_priori_exclusions.why: Excluded BEFORE measurement on face validity: these are rhetorical intensifiers / bare referents, not correction speech acts. 'Let me be clear' is standard political filler and would swamp the numerator with non-corrections.

placebo_lexicon.rationale: PLACEBO CONTROL (#5). Register-matched first-person routine vocabulary with NO theoretical link to Friday. If Friday 'excess' appears here too, any walk-back Friday excess is a Friday composition artifact, not a Dump.

positive_control.rationale: INSTRUMENT VALIDATION. Week-ending vocabulary SHOULD be Friday-shaped. If the machinery cannot find a Friday effect here, a null on walk-backs is uninformative. This is what makes a REFUTED verdict mean something.

recon_probe_NOT_prereg.rationale: The orchestrator's 12-form recon probe, reproduced verbatim for comparison ONLY. Reported, never used as the gate.

controls_declared: #1 rates never counts — every cell is hits/statements and hits/1k-words
#2 density/length control — per-1k-WORDS rate + within-length-quartile weekday ratios (corrections are short; length is a live confound on the numerator)
#3 same-weekday baselines — Friday vs Mon-Thu mean RATE; raw Friday volume (75k) vs Wednesday (94k) makes counts meaningless
#5 placebo — placebo lexicon + matched non-holiday-eve dates for the holiday arm
#7 power floor stated above before looking
#8 party symmetry — identical forms/thresholds both parties, never normalized to parity
#9 no silent caps — full weekday x half x party grid emitted, no top-N on the gate
unit_note: Primary cell = statement-level rate (spec says per-1k). Secondary = OFFICE-DAY rate (does office X emit >=1 walk-back on day D) — collapses joint/syndicated releases and volume-per-office. Both reported.
multi_speaker_note: A press release is multi-speaker. `attributed_to_other` (pipeline/duet.py) is applied to a sample of core hits to report what fraction of walk-back language is a QUOTED third party rather than the releasing office. The weekday claim is about WHEN, not WHO, so this is a disclosure not a filter.
